name: elagoht/validate
description: A collage plugin for validating a form an action receives.

templateFunctions.name: fieldError
templateFunctions.doc: The message for a field a refused submission failed, or empty.

templateFunctions.name: fieldValue
templateFunctions.doc: What was submitted for a field, to fill the input again after a refusal; `fallback` on the first render. Passwords are never echoed.

templateFunctions.name: hasErrors
templateFunctions.doc: Whether the submission being shown again was refused.

body: <input id="$1" name="$1" type="${3:text}" value="{{fieldValue "$1"}}"{{with fieldError "$1"}} aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="$1-error"{{end}}>
collage-validate field.description: collage-validate: an input that shows its error and keeps what was typed

collage-validate form error.description: collage-validate: the message a handler gave the whole form, with v.Fail("form", …)

collage-validate textarea.description: collage-validate: a textarea with the submitted value and its message

config.description: A collage plugin for validating a form an action receives.

localeMessages.description: LocaleMessages replaces messages for one locale, the render's: {"tr": {"required": "Bu alan zorunludur."}}. It is looked at before Messages.

messages.description: Messages replaces the English message of a rule, for every locale: {"required": "Please fill this in."}. A message may name the check's value in braces — {min}, {max}, {options}, {other} — which is replaced rather than formatted with fmt, so a translation that leaves the value out, or puts it elsewhere, is still correct. A key that is not a rule stops the application from starting.

noRefill.description: NoRefill names the fields whose submitted value is never put back in the form, matched case-insensitively as parts of the field's name. Unset, it is ["password"]: a password typed back into the page would sit in its HTML, in the browser's history and in any proxy that keeps it. Set, it replaces that default, so a list of your own should say "password" too.
